description: Wave 6D-5 confirmed-match and settled-observation read-only probes for Script Compiler, VM, Null Call Context, Player-Source Commands, Temporary Scene Bases, and UDF/Lambda semantics (27 disjoint probes).

batches.title: Wave 6D-5 Confirmed Matches and Settled Observations

probes.claim: SD-01: Verify %x width digits (0/4/8) on positive & negative ints, %a ASCII codes, %{ ... %} conditional/nested/unclosed blocks, %z on non-string values, and format specifier count mismatches in sv_Construct vs SetFormDescription.
probes.expected: NVForever vm.rs:2591 formats negative %x as 64-bit i64 (16 hex digits), rejects too-few args in sv_Construct, and silently returns 0 in SetFormDescription.
script_lines: PrintToConsole "PROBE|w6d5_03_format_x_a_cond_mismatch|x(%z)|cond(%z)|uncl(%z)|extra(%z)|few(ok=%g,v=[%z])|descFew(ret=%g,txt=[%z])" svX svCond svUncl svExtra iFewOk svFewVal iDescFew svAfterFew

probes.claim: SD-03: Verify AnhNVSE ArrayToString output on list, numeric map, empty array, nested array, and ar_Null; plus invoke xNVSE PrintVar and Ar_Dump between sentinel markers to capture exact console format.
probes.expected: NVForever vm/anh.rs:257-260 formats ArrayToString as '[1, 2]' / '[k: v]' / '' for null, and vm.rs:1945/2898 use invented single-line dump/bracket formats for Ar_Dump and PrintVar.

PrintToConsole "PROBE|w6d5_05_arraytostring_printvar_ardump|list=[%z]|nmap=[%z]|emp=[%z]|nest=[%z]|null=[%z]" svAL svAM svAE svAN svAZ

probes.claim: SD-12: Compare RightShift -8 1 vs -8 >> 1 (unsigned vs arithmetic shift), LeftShift 1 31 vs 1 << 31, shift by >=32/-1, LogicalNot 0, GetBit/SetBit/ClearBit boundaries, and IntToBin prefix ('0b') & width.
probes.expected: NVForever vm.rs:3431 uses unsigned u32 checked_shr for RightShift [hypothesis] (returning 2147483644 for -8 >> 1) vs signed i64 for >> (-4), and vm.rs:3451 uses '0b' prefix for IntToBin [hypothesis].
script_lines: PrintToConsole "PROBE|w6d5_10_inttobin_bitshift_funcs_vs_ops|sh(rsF=%g,rsOp=%g,lsF=%g,lsOp=%g,rs32=%g,ls32=%g,rsNeg=%g)|bit(not0=%g,gb=%g/%g/%g,sb=%g,cb=%g)|bin(0=[%z],8=[%z],p=[%z],n=[%z])|hexN=[%z]" rsFunc rsOp lsFunc lsOp rs32 ls32 rsNeg lnot0 gb0 gb31 gb32 sb1 cb1 b0 b8 bP bN hN

probes.claim: SD-11: Verify whether && and || short-circuit RHS side-effect calls in let, while, TestExpr, and if eval, plus verify deciding-operand return values on numbers, refs, strings, and arrays.
probes.expected: ext-syntax.md:111 marks short-circuiting outside eval as open; NVForever short-circuits all extended expressions and coerces non-number deciding operands to 1/0.

probes.claim: SD-09 & SD-14: Verify ForEach over ar_Null, empty list, empty string, FLST (post-loop var state), and ar_Erase during iteration; plus Label/GoTo backward loop, forward GoTo, GoTo out of If, and Label 255 vs 256.
probes.expected: NVForever vm.rs:1989 errors on ForEach over non-array, preserves FLST iterator var after loop, supports forward GoTo in same statement list, and has no 0..=255 Label cap.
script_lines: PrintToConsole "PROBE|w6d5_20_foreach_edges_and_label_goto|fe(nullOk=%g,empA=%g,empS=%g,flst=%g:post=%g,mutSum=%g:sz=%g)|goto(%g:[%z])|l256(%g:%g)" feNullOk cEmpA cEmpS cFlst flstPostValid sumMut (ar_Size aMut) (fGoto != 0) svGoto (fLab256 != 0) r256

probes.claim: SD-10: Verify whether an explicit null ref receiver (ref rNull = 0) aborts the script or returns 0 and continues on vanilla commands (GetDisabled standalone/if/let, GetAV Health, GetPos Z, GetItemCount, vanilla set).
probes.expected: NVForever Vm::call/xcall does not emit no_reference_call on null ref and relies on per-command Host::call error returns, whereas o5_00 observed rNull.GetDisabled continuing in a UDF.
script_lines: PrintToConsole "PROBE|w6d5_21_null_ref_vanilla_commands|disStmt=%g|disLet=%g|av=%g|pos=%g|cnt=%g|set(v=%g,ok=%g)" d1 d2 av ps cn iSetV iSetOk

probes.claim: SD-10: Verify explicit null receiver (ref rNull = 0) across NVSE/JIP commands routed through distinct NVForever VM paths (string_function vs out_call vs host_function).
probes.expected: NVForever silently returns 0 and continues for string_function & out_call (GetBaseObject/GetType/GetPosEx) but aborts with VmError::NoReference for host_function (GetRefType/GetName/AuxVarGetFlt).

probes.claim: Verify explicit null receiver on ListGetCount (1-arg) and GetPosEx (3-outvar).
probes.expected: Check whether ListGetCount and GetPosEx continue or abort on rNull.

probes.claim: SD-10: Verify calling vanilla and NVSE/JIP commands with a BASE form (Caps001 0xF MISC or DocMitchell 0x104C0C NPC_) as the explicit calling reference.
probes.expected: NVForever passes base forms through Vm::call/string_function while host_function aborts only if ext_call returns NoReference wording.

probes.claim: SD-10: Verify RemoveReputationExact fractional loss, floor clamp at 0, negative amount, zero amount, above-scale subtraction, invalid axis (axis=2 abort vs continue), and explicit Doc/null receivers.
probes.expected: NVForever player_source.rs delegates to reputation::write_axis (aborts on axis=2) and reputation::change (clamps loss at 0, negative amount adds up to scale) and allows explicit null receivers [hypothesis].
script_lines: PrintToConsole "PROBE|w6d5_25_player_source_remove_rep_exact_edges|vals(sub=%.2f,z=%.2f,neg=%.2f,flr=%.2f,abv=%.2f)|ax2=%g|rcvr(doc=%g:%.2f,null=%g:%.2f)" vSub vZero vNeg vFlr vAbv (Player.AuxVarGetFlt "*w6d5_25_ax2") (Player.AuxVarGetFlt "*w6d5_25_doc") vDoc (Player.AuxVarGetFlt "*w6d5_25_null") vNull

probes.claim: SD-11: Verify clone-of-clone PlaceAtMe admission, post-placement SetModelPath on placed clone & original STAT, and whether TempCloneForm of a scripted NPC_ (DocMitchell) inherits the original's script.
probes.expected: NVForever objects.rs:47-56 refuses PlaceAtMe on clone-of-clone, refuses post-placement SetModelPath on placed clone/original, and temporary-scene-bases.md:63 notes clones do not inherit scripts.
script_lines: PrintToConsole "PROBE|w6d5_29_tempcloneform_chain_and_post_place_edit|chain(ic2=%g,p2=%g)|post(c1=[%z],orig=[%z],c1After=[%z])|scr(origValid=%g,eq=%g)" ic2 okP2 mC1 mOrig mC1After (sOrig != 0) (sClone == sOrig)

probes.claim: SD-12: Verify vanilla if mixed &&/|| precedence (0 && 1 || 1: || tighter than && in vanilla vs && tighter than || in if eval), grouped inline call operand inside vanilla if with mixed &&/||, spaced-dot receiver (Player .GetAV Strength), and vanilla Set with grouped call.
probes.expected: NVForever gen.rs:844-879 bridges grouped call operands inside vanilla expressions while keeping vanilla || > && precedence [hypothesis].

probes.claim: SD-12: Verify inline-declared variable scope across if/while blocks, parenthesized out-var inline declarations Player.GetPosEx (float px) (float py) (float pz), inline decl inside if TestExpr and if (int n = 5) == 5, and nested inline decl in initializer.
probes.expected: NVForever parse.rs:301 treats all inline declarations as script-scoped and supports parenthesized out-var declarations [hypothesis].

probes.claim: Disambiguate inline decl in `if TestExpr (int iTe = 77)` vs `if (int iEq = 5) == 5` vs `if eval (int iEq = 5) == 5`.
probes.expected: Identify which inline-decl-in-if forms compile in xNVSE 6.4.9.

probes.claim: SD-12: Verify runtime compiler refusal boundaries: fractional literals for xNVSE int params (ar_Init 2.5, sv_SubString 1.5) vs plugin int param (SetBaseKarma 37.5 vs 37.0 vs float var), untyped GetPackageLocation passed to GetFormIDString vs IsFormValid, and bare hex form IDs (f, 14).
probes.expected: NVForever gen/x.rs:929-957 permits fractional literals for xNVSE functions [hypothesis], refuses non-zero fractional literals for plugin int params (allowing 37.0 [hypothesis]), and refuses UNTYPED_RESULTS in ANY form param [hypothesis].

probes.claim: SD-13: Verify exact UDF recursion nesting limit (depths 10, 29, 30, 31, 35), max depth reached, return value at overflow, and whether the caller continues after overflow.
probes.expected: NVForever game.rs:2555 sets MAX_UDF_DEPTH = 30 and returns an error on the 31st nested call; ext-udf.md:66 leaves exact 31st-call return value open.

probes.claim: SD-13: Verify (a) lambda returned from a UDF and invoked twice AFTER the UDF returns (captured local persistence), (b) reassigning a ref variable holding a lambda under the ordinary compiler, and (c) one-line lambda with chained assignment ({} => iA = iB = 7).
probes.expected: NVForever game.rs:7935/4038 captures Temp locals into LambdaDef.captured [hypothesis] and allows reassigning lambda ref vars; ext-udf.md:114/126/134 leaves all three open.

probes.expected: NVForever vm.rs:3474 supports nested let in eval, parse.rs:135 joins spaced ': =', gen/x.rs:527 turns unknown bare word in parens into string, and ext-syntax.md:370 resolves bare AV keywords on extender functions.
